releaseNotes: POAMForge AI / Elysium 1.2.5. Last released build for clients still pinned to /poamforge/latest.json. OLMo 3.7B is the compiled default LLM; Bonsai 8B remains supported as the rollback path. Completes the Elysium rebrand in operator-facing strings. This manifest reports the version field clients already run so an up-to-date 1.2.5 client is told it is current.

windows-x86_64.note: There is no url key here, on purpose. The 1.2.5 installer is not hosted on this update server (GitHub Pages serves manifests only, no binaries), and it is UNSIGNED. The client's PlatformEntry.url is Option<String>, so an absent url deserializes to None and download_url becomes an empty string: nothing 404s and no installer is offered. Add a url only when a signed 1.2.5+ artifact is actually hosted and returns 200.

successorNote: POAMForge AI was renamed Elysium at 1.3.0. This manifest stays at the last released version (1.2.5) for clients still pinned to /poamforge/latest.json; it is bumped only when a SIGNED newer build exists and is hosted. New clients check /elysium/latest.json.
